record_type_quote: The present study reports a preregistered replication of a study by Stoeber (2012) investigating the relationships between dyadic perfectionism, relationship satisfaction and longterm commitment.

targets.title: Dyadic perfectionism in romantic relationships: Predicting relationship satisfaction and longterm commitment.
targets.evidence_quote: The aim of the present study was therefore to conduct a preregistered replication of Stoeber (2012).
targets.outcome_quote: The findings were mixed: We were able to reproduce some of the relationships reported by Stoeber, some failed to reproduce, and some new relationships were found.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Authors explicitly characterize their replication as mixed; the discussion describes both agreements and contradictions.

reasoning: A completed preregistered study collected new data from 71 couples. One cited original paper is explicitly re-tested; other sources motivate the study or supply measures.
